info.title: DamdAImin API
info.description: Versioned application API for authenticated DamdAImin journeys.

get.summary: List the authenticated account's Analysis History

post.summary: Finalize Source Audio and queue an Analysis
Create a private Source Audio upload operation
Generate an editable transcript preview for uploaded Source Audio
Cancel a queued or processing Analysis
Retry a failed Analysis while retained Source Audio exists

delete.summary: Delete one owned Analysis and its associated content
